source_request:
상반신 클로즈업, 좀더 갸름한 얼굴, 미간이 좁고, 큰 눈, clear translucent skin with visible fine pores and realistic natural texture,
fresh bare-skin impression,
subtle inner luminosity,
soft natural blood tone beneath the skin,
no beauty-filter smoothing, no waxy skin, no heavy foundation, soft rose-beige lips with a natural satin finish,
gently closed lips,
delicate natural volume,
defined but understated lip texture,
not glossy, not overlined

scene_delta.title: Lia - Natural Skin Texture Close-up
scene_delta.pose: Upper body close-up, head tilted slightly, looking directly into the lens with a calm, steady gaze.
scene_delta.expression: A faint, quiet, unposed natural smile; calm and serene expression.
scene_delta.outfit: Minimalist, simple top, emphasizing the bare-skin impression of the face and neck.
scene_delta.lens: 85mm prime lens, shallow depth of field.
scene_delta.lighting: Soft, diffused natural window light, highlighting the skin's subtle inner luminosity and fine texture without harsh shadows.
scene_delta.action: Posing naturally, maintaining direct eye contact.
scene_delta.styling: Bare-skin makeup look, focusing on realistic skin texture and fine pores; soft rose-beige lips with a natural satin finish; lived-in near-black hair with soft full bangs falling naturally.
scene_delta.negative_constraints: Beauty filter, heavy foundation, waxy skin, glossy lips, overlined lips, sharp V-line face, wide-set eyes, heavy makeup, airbrushed skin, plastic texture, exaggerated features, jewelry (except the three thin red-and-blue knotted bracelets on the right wrist).
